meta.title: Tartaruga Sea-Bar — A day at the lighthouse
meta.description: Sea-bar by the Punta Colorada lighthouse. Sea, fire and sunset. Book a table.

hero.title: A day at the lighthouse
hero.lead: The sea one step away, fire at the table, the sun taking its time. Here the day is measured in tides and embers.

lugar.title: The deck leans into the wind
lugar.p1: Metres from the Punta Colorada lighthouse, Maldonado. Not a postcard: the place where it gets late without you noticing.
lugar.p2: Wood, iron, cactus and a 180-degree horizon. Ocean on one side, peninsula on the other. A table in between.

carta.title: Whatever the tide brings
carta.lead: Coastal catch, embers, a pot that refuses to hurry. DEMO prices, to confirm.

fuego.title: Night cooks slowly
fuego.lead: Brazier, hearth and the iron pot on its tripod. The sea goes black; the embers do not.

pet.title: Bring the dog
pet.lead: Fresh water, shade under the table, the same horizon. The sea belongs to everyone.

artesanal.title: Iron, wood, salt
artesanal.lead: Pierced oxidised sculptures, sun-warmed decks, fire that is not décor. All made by hand, metres from the lighthouse.

galeria.title: What stays on the retina
